correctness.rationale: For quadratic character chi in Fq with q=1 mod 4, normalized off-diagonal 2x2 blocks are orthogonal reflections; the product along a 3-index triangle is reflection with eigenvalues +-1. Independent plane-basis gauging reduces the 6x6 off-diagonal block adjacency to signed scalar triangles with spectra (2,-1,-1) and (-2,1,1); hence the universal Gram spectrum 1+-2/sqrt(q-1), 1+-1/sqrt(q-1) twice. For q=13 the antilinear representation M=[C sqrt11 S;sqrt11 S -C] gives ±-paired eigenvalues and squared roots of H=KK*, K=C+i sqrt11 S. Independently enumerated all C(13,4)=715 quartets with exact integer-ring matrix products/Newton identities, reproduced four coefficient types with multiplicities 78,390,195,52 and unique maximum root 108. Exceptional 52 cases equal affine images of {0,1,3,9}, so delta4=sqrt108/12=sqrt3/2. Cross-checked q=5 and q=13 triple spectra. This finite q=13 exhaustive check does not prove four-block formulas for general q.
